steps.title: Analyze Build Failures
steps.description: Inspect the gradle error logs to identify incorrect XML namespace declarations and manifest configuration issues.

steps.title: Fix Display Background Namespace
steps.description: Update display_bg.xml to use the correct schema URI http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android instead of the incorrect google.com URI.

steps.title: Refactor Android Manifest Configuration
steps.description: Remove the deprecated package attribute from AndroidManifest.xml and use fully qualified class name for MainActivity.

steps.title: Clean build.gradle Dependencies
steps.description: Remove the redundant external nanohttpd dependency from app/build.gradle to strictly utilize built-in SDK components.

steps.title: Verify Style Themes
steps.description: Confirm application theme parent refers to system-supported Material Light/Dark configurations inside styles.xml.

steps.title: Review Keypad Layout XML
steps.description: Check activity_main.xml layout and key button IDs for direct layout alignment and compatibility.

steps.title: Validate Button Event Listeners
steps.description: Ensure all numeric and scientific action button IDs in MainActivity.java map correctly to the layout.

steps.title: Test Recursive Descent Mathematical Parser
steps.description: Validate parenthetical, trigonometric, logarithm, and square root calculations inside parser logic.

steps.title: Optimize Number Formatting
steps.description: Ensure final result presentation trims redundant trailing zeros and handles division by zero safely.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Execute gradle assembler tasks to build application code, package APK resources and finalize process.
